name: DreamOS image (mkosi, unsigned)
script:
set -x
# /work/src = DreamScape/DreamOS at the requested ref; runs as root in a privileged container (mkosi: loop devices, systemd-repart, mounts).
# Params (env): FLAVOR=dev|release, VERSION (default image/mkosi.version), CLEAN=1 for a cold package layer, DEV_PUBKEY (dev images: the key that may ssh in as "dream").
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
export HOME=/root
cd /work/src
mkdir -p /cache/mkosi-cache out && rm -rf image/mkosi.cache && ln -s /cache/mkosi-cache image/mkosi.cache
export DREAMOS_CACHE_TMPFS=0
VER=${VERSION:-$(cat image/mkosi.version)}
export DREAMOS_VERSION=$VER
ARGS=(--no-share)
[ "${CLEAN:-0}" = 1 ] && ARGS+=(--clean)
if [ "${FLAVOR:-dev}" = dev ]; then printf '%s\n' "$DEV_PUBKEY" > /tmp/dev.pub; ARGS+=(--dev-key /tmp/dev.pub); fi
T0=$(date +%s); echo "[rack] dreamos $VER ${FLAVOR:-dev} commit $RACK_COMMIT start $(date -Is), $(nproc) cpus visible"
tools/build-image.sh "${ARGS[@]}"
T1=$(date +%s)
mkdir -p /out
for n in raw efi recovery.efi root.raw root-verity.raw hw-full.raw packs.raw esp.raw; do
  f=out/dreamos_$VER.$n; [ -f "$f" ] && cp --sparse=always "$f" /out/ || echo "[rack] no $f"
done
install -m 0755 cafeready/target/release/cafeready /out/cafeready
cp image/mkosi.extra/usr/lib/dreamos/api-level /out/api-level 2>/dev/null || true
printf '{"version":"%s","flavor":"%s","commit":"%s","buildSeconds":%s,"finished":"%s"}\n' "$VER" "${FLAVOR:-dev}" "$RACK_COMMIT" $((T1-T0)) "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > /out/build-info.json
(cd /out && sha256sum dreamos_* cafeready > SHA256SUMS)
echo "[rack] built $VER in $((T1-T0))s; end $(date -Is)"
